name: Bulgaria

elections.note: Run-off between Iliana Iotova and Andrey Gyurov. First round 25 October 2026 (CIK final results): Iotova 34.76%, Gyurov 31.95%; turnout 23.2%.
elections.noteIs: Seinni umferð milli Iliönu Iotovu og Andrey Gyurov. Fyrri umferð 25. október 2026 (lokatölur CIK): Iotova 34,76%, Gyurov 31,95%; kjörsókn 23,2%.

leaders: President Iliana Iotova; Prime Minister Rumen Radev (Progressive Bulgaria)
leadersIs: Iliana Iotova forseti; Rumen Radev forsætisráðherra (Framsækin Búlgaría)
summary: Iliana Iotova, backed by Prime Minister Rumen Radev, led the first round on 25 October with 34.76% against 31.95% for the pro-EU reformist Andrey Gyurov (CIK final results), so the two meet in a run-off on 1 November. Turnout was a record low of 23.2% (1,525,034 of 6,584,025 voters), according to the CIK.
summaryIs: Iliana Iotova, sem Rumen Radev forsætisráðherra styður, var efst í fyrri umferðinni 25. október með 34,76% en Evrópusinnaði umbótamaðurinn Andrey Gyurov fékk 31,95% (lokatölur CIK), svo þau mætast í seinni umferð 1. nóvember. Kjörsókn var 23,2% (1.525.034 af 6.584.025 kjósendum) samkvæmt CIK, sú minnsta frá upphafi.

lastElection.outcome: No candidate won a majority. CIK final results put Iliana Iotova on 34.76% (528,951 votes) and Andrey Gyurov on 31.95% (486,232), with Kostadin Kostadinov third on 12.55%; turnout was a record low of 23.2%.
lastElection.outcomeIs: Enginn frambjóðandi fékk meirihluta. Samkvæmt lokatölum CIK fékk Iliana Iotova 34,76% (528.951 atkvæði) og Andrey Gyurov 31,95% (486.232), en Kostadin Kostadinov varð þriðji með 12,55%; kjörsókn var 23,2%, sú minnsta frá upphafi.
